pages.text: Every radio is built around a quartz $(item)crystal$() cut for its band (80, 40, 20, 10 m or VHF). You find them while digging $(thing)sand$(), about one block in eighty, mostly poor ones. Encase one in iron before using it.

Crystals come in three qualities:$(li)$(thing)Pure$() makes a $(thing)Premium$() radio: a touch less static.$(li)$(thing)Good$() makes the plain radio.$(li)$(thing)Poor$() makes a $(thing)Cheap$() radio that slowly drifts off frequency, and that can go up in smoke spectacularly if you $(l:radiocraft:radios/swr_and_blown_radios)abuse it$(/l).
pages.title: Quality

pages.text: Swap a radio's crystal by crafting the radio with an encased crystal of another quality.
